title: Nice blanket
text:
Nice blanket. Hi, I ordered this blanket “used like new” as a Christmas present. I realize I took a chance buying it as a gift, and I was right. It has two dirty spots on it. Looks like it was picked up with soiled hands. Also, it’s not super soft either, a bit scratchy. You can see the spots on both sides near the top.
Update:
Darn, there’s a spot on the other side too
